I placed a large online order on February 21 (this item included). That same day, I received two emails: first, an order confirmation, and second, a notice that the order was being packed and might arrive in multiple shipments. After that, I received no additional emails or delivery notifications—and no package. I thoroughly searched my property, including around bushes and entry areas, and checked with neighbors. The package was nowhere to be found. On March 2, I contacted customer service via text. I received a message stating the order "should be delivered March 2," along with a tracking link. The link showed a carrier tracking number indicating the package had actually been delivered on February 23. When I asked about the discrepancy, I was told to check my yard and neighbors. I confirmed that I had already done so and that the package was still missing. The response was that the issue would be elevated. On March 4, I followed up again via text. After having to repeat the entire situation, I was told there was nothing that could be done because both Ulta and the carrier show the package as delivered. I requested photo proof confirming delivery to the correct address and asked that the order either be resent or refunded so I could purchase the items in-store. My request for proof of delivery was ignored, and I was told Ulta could neither resend the package nor issue a refund. I then asked for the issue to be escalated to a supervisor and was connected quickly. She expresse
